execution.resume: only --execute-registered --resume against hash-verified gate checkpoints, evaluation journals, and this complete run identity

learned_gate.input: the immutable fixed-depth-v1 prelude encoding of canonical JSON containing family, current turn, and query; no split label, target operation, expected answer, or future turn is encoded
learned_gate.architecture: one affine map from 472 dimensions to four logits; no hidden layer, recurrence, attention, adapter, or learned readout
learned_gate.decision: argmax over operation_order; an exact tie selects the lowest registered operation index
learned_gate.boundary_failure: an invalid predicted operation fails closed for that turn and is counted as a policy error; it never falls back to the registered target

target_derivation.remember: initial remember turns and the first similar-fact variant
target_derivation.update: declared update turns and verified contradiction turns
target_derivation.merge: the second and later similar-fact variants
target_derivation.forget: the pre-reset turn in reset/task-switch tasks

operation_realization.remember: stage the current verified turn as a new exact-key slot
operation_realization.update: replace the active exact-key slot value and support while preserving superseded support
operation_realization.merge: stage the current verified similar-fact turn, then merge that slot with the active variant or prior variant-summary slot; both boundary operations are charged and journaled
operation_realization.forget: remove active task slots with explicit-user reason immediately before the non-neural mandatory reset
operation_realization.mandatory_non_neural_controls: reset, expiry, evidence validation, poison rejection, exact capacity, and support invalidation execute regardless of gate logits

gate_training.schedule: four independently shuffled operation queues cycle without omission; four examples are drawn from each queue and the resulting batch is shuffled
gate_training.feature_cache: derived per seed from the exact frozen core and discarded or hash-bound; it is never shared across core seeds

arm_semantics.explicit-multiview-v1: rebuild the complete resolved task view at query time and select the current verified exact-key value; retain no native session slots
arm_semantics.deterministic-session-cache-v1: apply declared remember/update/reset semantics to an exact-key sixteen-slot cache; ignore distractor, decay-pressure, and unverified poison turns
arm_semantics.minimal-gated-native-memory-v1: apply only the learned gate decision through the E0.15 authority boundary; reset, expiry, poison rejection, evidence reinjection, and capacity enforcement remain non-neural
arm_semantics.common_readout: present the arm-selected current value, query, and ledger-only support to the unchanged fixed-depth core using one bounded canonical prompt; exact canonical-JSON decoder output is the task answer

evaluation.gate_auxiliary_metric: operation classification accuracy, reported separately and never substituted for task accuracy

required_secondary_reports.correction_latency: turns and realized FLOPs from the final verified correction/update to the first correct authority-bound answer; failures remain censored and are never imputed as successes
required_secondary_reports.reset_leakage: fraction of reset/task-switch tasks returning any pre-reset value; the registered maximum is zero
required_secondary_reports.capacity_saturation_curve: authority-bound selected-value accuracy, policy errors, serialized bytes, and memory FLOPs at forced occupancies 0, 4, 8, 12, and 16 on the lexicographically first OOD delayed-recall task for every paired seed; filler keys are derived from the task ID and cite only that task's already registered verified support
required_secondary_reports.unsupported_durable_writes: count of direct ledger writes or durable proposals without ledger-only observed support; the registered maximum is zero
required_secondary_reports.post_invalidation_performance: on the same registered OOD delayed-recall probe, tombstone the queried slot's support immediately before readout and report whether a pre-invalidation slot existed, whether it was disabled, and whether a stale value was emitted; required disable rate is 1.0 when a slot existed and maximum stale rate is zero

evaluation.common_core_calls: one final fixed-depth readout per task in every arm
evaluation.additional_gate_calls: one frozen-core prelude call per gate-eligible turn; counted separately
evaluation.journaling: append-only per-task records keyed by run manifest, seed, arm, split, and task ID; duplicate keys must be byte-identical
evaluation.accuracy_read_boundary: no ID, OOD, family, protected-region, or promotion metric may be read during preflight or checkpoint/resume validation

compute_and_storage.model_inference_flops: analytical fixed-core forward FLOPs recorded separately for final readout and gate feature calls
compute_and_storage.gate_flops: two FLOPs per input-weight pair plus one bias operation for each of four logits
compute_and_storage.memory_flops: the exact E0.15 native-memory accounting record
compute_and_storage.explicit_view_flops: two FLOPs per canonical input byte plus eight FLOPs per task event scanned
compute_and_storage.storage: exact native slot bytes, deterministic cache bytes, gate checkpoint bytes, and evaluation journal bytes reported separately
compute_and_storage.compute_normalized_score: task exactness multiplied by 100000000 and divided by total realized inference FLOPs; paired by core seed

statistics.test: one-sided paired Student-t with registered finite-sample critical values
statistics.multiple_comparisons: Holm step-down within the learned-versus-explicit and learned-versus-cache OOD family
statistics.learned_ood_superiority: both Holm-adjusted lower bounds must exceed 0.0
statistics.id_noninferiority: learned minus each simpler arm lower bound must be at least -0.02
statistics.protected_region_noninferiority: learned minus each simpler arm lower bound must be at least 0.0 in every registered protected region
statistics.compute_normalized_superiority: learned minus each simpler arm lower bound must exceed 0.0
statistics.deterministic_cache_superiority: cache minus explicit OOD lower bound exceeds 0.0 with no ID or protected-region violation
statistics.zero_variance: a strictly positive constant paired delta has an infinite statistic and a zero delta does not reject

secondary_thresholds.capacity_curve_rule: report every registered point; no pooled accuracy can conceal a capacity-specific authority, deletion, reset, byte-cap, or protected-region failure
secondary_thresholds.correction_latency_rule: learned memory must answer every registered correction and temporal-update case correctly and may not exceed the slower simpler arm's paired median turn latency while claiming a promotion

post_training_manipulations: M1 frozen core model and optimizer state hashes remain exact
M2 replacing learned decisions with a fixed operation changes at least one state trace
M3 omitted reinjected support fails before a model call
M4 tombstoned support disables the affected slot before readout
M5 reset and cross-owner access leave no readable state
M6 slot or byte overflow fails closed
M7 stale gate, core, or ontology checkpoint identity fails restore
M8 unverified poison cannot enter active memory
M9 protected-region state cannot be removed by automatic decay
M10 memory identifiers cannot appear in answer evidence
M11 every model, gate, memory, retrieval, and storage operation is accounted
decision_precedence: INVALID if any identity, authority, evidence, split, journal, accounting, checkpoint, manipulation, or finite-value invariant fails
INCOMPLETE if any registered seed, arm, split, task, gate update, or evaluation row is missing
reject learned memory for persistent use if any deletion, reset, poison, unsupported-write, or protected-region violation occurs
adopt learned memory only if both primary and compute-normalized learned gates pass
classify a primary-only learned gain as COMPLETE_COMPUTE_ONLY_ACCELERATOR
retain a learned module for one family only when exactly one registered OOD family passes and every safety gate passes
otherwise retain deterministic cache if its gate passes; retain explicit multiview in every other complete case

failure_states.NOT_RUN: the explicit execution flag has not consumed the frozen budget
failure_states.INCOMPLETE: the frozen identity remains resumable and at least one registered unit is unfinished
failure_states.INVALID: the run identity or a non-resumable integrity invariant failed; a new versioned protocol is required

excluded_scope: changes to the fixed-depth core, its macro depth, or its selected checkpoint identities
a second learned memory architecture or learned answer readout
native memory as ledger authority or evidence root
MoE, LoRA, continual weight updates, consolidation, autonomous promotion, or self-improvement
